requirement: Keep all current Hiver human-facing routes unless a content audit approves a closer canonical destination. Keep trailing slash, lowercase and hyphen convention stable.
acceptance: Hiver legacy route inventory has a decision for every row; no route is silently dropped.

requirement: Do not treat the 253 Nexly routes as Hiver legacy URLs. Store them as reference-only and never publish/redirect them without evidence Hiver owned them.
acceptance: Every Nexly reference row has DO_NOT_REDIRECT_ON_HIVER status.

requirement: Use server-side 301/308 only for a real moved/merged Hiver URL, direct to the closest final target, avoid chains, and retain redirects at least one year after a move.
acceptance: Redirect CSV, Apache/Nginx rules and curl test log agree; no mass home redirect.

requirement: Each canonical page has one absolute self-referencing canonical; internal links and sitemap use the same canonical; no robots.txt canonicalization.
acceptance: Rendered source and crawl agree with page SEO inventory.

requirement: Only final canonical indexable URLs appear in XML sitemap. Exclude noindex pages, redirects, 404/410, query parameters, media not intended for Search and reference-only URLs.
acceptance: Sitemap row count equals approved canonical indexable count after QA.

requirement: Audit theme/plugins/templates/widgets/fonts/scripts; remove construction/demos, placeholder content and unnecessary assets; use cache/CDN/image optimization and keep one builder system.
acceptance: Plugin/asset register and staging crawl approved.

requirement: Measure real-user LCP ≤2.5s, INP ≤200ms and CLS ≤0.1 at the 75th percentile as Google’s good thresholds; do not promise scores before field data.
acceptance: Mobile/desktop field baseline and post-launch report exist.

requirement: Semantic headings, keyboard navigation, visible focus, form labels/errors, contrast, reduced motion, accessible menus and meaningful alt text; use qualified WCAG 2.2 AA review.
acceptance: Manual keyboard and automated accessibility logs exist; no unsupported compliance claim.

requirement: Track form_start, form_submit, generate_lead, book_call only when real, CTA clicks, phone/email/WhatsApp and CRM lifecycle from lead to win.
acceptance: Test events and CRM IDs are linked; consent settings are documented.

requirement: Backups, updates, WAF/spam controls, least-privilege accounts, privacy/cookie consent, retention and security owner. Replace public superadmin authorship.
acceptance: Security and privacy checklist signed by owner/counsel.

requirement: No country doorway pages or hreflang until distinct localized variants and real local evidence exist. Use one factual international-delivery page.
acceptance: No duplicate geo pages; hreflang omitted until eligible.

requirement: Named author/reviewer, update dates, evidence register, version control and a rule that unverified claims remain blocked.
acceptance: Every indexable page has an owner, source/proof status and next review date.
